ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 60% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the peduncle connection and margins, versus 40% high-intensity (white) pixels in the lateral lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous white regions localized to the distal areas of the left and right lobes. These are surrounded by thick low-intensity black borders at the trailing edges and a wide black central column spanning from the notch to the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression at the center; the angle is approximately 55 degrees with a significant pixel depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; frequency increases toward the tips with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from fine-grain jaggedness to larger scalloped indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curve from the median notch extending laterally, terminating in a sharp upward (dorsal) sweep at the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, circular white-and-grey protrusions (barnacles) concentrated heavily along the distal tips and leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white patches on both lobes; notably, three prominent vertical/diagonal marks on the left lobe and several horizontal/diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent tooth rake marks on the ventral surface; heavy barnacle encrustation on the lateral margins and tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized tan-colored pixel staining (likely diatom film) visible in the upper-inner quadrant of the white region on the right lobe.
